citations.assessment: The exact Yerushalmi confirms Chanan as father of Shimon. Its transmitter chain reads Rabbi (Shimon) ben Levi, distinct from the received abbreviation expanded as Shimon ben Lakish.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

holds.reason: The exact Yerushalmi reads Rabbi (Shimon) ben Levi. Keep the source siglum’s Shimon ben Lakish rendering as a received reading pending collation.
